description: Controller-owned defaults for the AI adoption effectiveness benchmark. An agent cannot read, change or override these values; the controller loads this file, freezes the limits, and records them in every run.

fake.description: Deterministic scripted adapter. Requires no model, no network and no credentials.

freebuff.description: Capability probe for the locally installed Freebuff CLI. Registered as a boundary; execution is refused while no supported unattended invocation exists.

sandbox.localIsolationNote: This host has no container runtime. 'auto' therefore falls back to a local process sandbox and records, per run, that network and read-only enforcement are not guaranteed. Set allowLocalIsolation to false to fail closed instead.
